faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by District Court Varanasi for re-employment of retired personnel across various administrative and support roles on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 104 vacancies available for various posts including Senior Assistant, Stenographer, Daftari, Aadeshika Wahak, and Office Peon.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Only retired district court employees meeting the specific post requirements are eligible to apply for these re-employment opportunities.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts under this re-employment notification is restricted to 65 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary for the re-employed candidates will be calculated as their last drawn pay minus the pension they are currently receiving.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application for District Court Varanasi Recruitment is strictly offline. Candidates must download, fill, and mail the application form.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled application form along with necessary enclosures is 31 October 2026 up to 04:00 PM.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: The completed application form along with self-attested copies of the PPO and other required documents must be sent to the office of the District Judge, Varanasi.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the re-employment positions will be based strictly on an interview conducted by the competent authority.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification released by the District Court Varanasi for these offline positions.
